He owns the house we currently live in, his (separated) wife's house, and a bar that has 2 apartments above it. I've recently thought about just selling my quarter of the house to my siblings, and the entire bar to them or anyone else who wants it. WIBTA if I decided to leave my mom out of anything I get from my dad's will?
